name: OmaPlugs Browser
author: JesusLovesYou1013
description:
Browse, add, enable, disable, update and remove every available Omarchy shell plugin, including marketplace screenshots, version history and update previews — all through Omarchy's own omarchy-plugin-* commands.
• Must be ENABLED to take effect: it then adds Setup › Plugins › Browse Plugins to your Omarchy menu.
• No bar icon. Disable or remove the plugin and the menu row is removed again.
